name: Dancing Lights

targets.description: Up to four lights at points within range, or one Medium humanlike form.

summary: Up to four hovering lights (or one glowing Medium form), each shedding Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.
text: You make up to four torch-sized lights appear within range, hovering for the duration and looking like torches, lanterns or glowing orbs; or you merge all four into one glowing form of Medium size with a vaguely humanlike shape. Each light, or the merged form, sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius. As a Bonus Action you can move the lights up to 60 feet to spaces within range. Each light must stay within 20 feet of another light from this spell, and a light that goes beyond the spell's range vanishes.
